assets.caption: Front yard of a small cozy log cabin in a pine forest at overcast dusk, seen at eye level from the middle of the yard. Facing the cabin: a wide covered wooden porch with three broad steps, a warm glowing lantern beside a closed red front door, a wooden bench, log walls with one warmly lit window, and a freshly dug empty muddy hole in bare soil beside the steps. To the right: the side of the cabin with a stacked woodpile under a small slanted roof, a rain barrel, and a big old pine tree with roots spreading over soft ground. Behind: a gravel path leading to a gap in a low split-rail fence with a mailbox on a post, a wide old tree stump on one side and a flower bed of loose dark soil on the other, dark pines beyond and a distant storm cloud bank. To the left: the fence curving past an old wooden wheelbarrow, ferns and tall grass. Damp gravel, grass and pine needles underfoot. Soft even blue-grey dusk light with warm amber accents from the lantern and window. Stylized semi-realistic animated-film look with hand-painted textures and rich teal, amber and magenta color. The yard is empty and still: no people, no animals.
